discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B014 (packets 214, 421, 463; Disney Store 2018). 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. Main yield: Disney Studio Store Hollywood 2018 dated LEs from DPB/DisKingdom (Snow White 80th surprise, Film Strip set, Marie Spring, Launchpad, Avengers group, 4 May character pins, 21 May Solo, Mulan 20th surprise, Cursive Cutie, Oct Halloween and NBC 25th, Pinsgiving BFF Photo Booth #1, Frozen 5th, Dec series, New Year 28 Dec) and PTD Aug 2018 wave. Holds kept: Marvel 10th, Aug Park Pack three, Rapunzel naming, RBI split/heart halves, Memories Jan Glove/Face/Walking, Incredibles EU. No hold released. New holds: Pinsgiving Cogsworth & Lumiere, MPR Friends pin, PTD Aug three (no edition sizes). Resellers (yourwdwstore, distradingpins4u, ecrater) not used.
